s: Verbier's rosé-terrace après-ski, sliding from long lunch into afternoon party
w: A restaurant and après-ski terrace with panoramic Valais views that captures Verbier's ski-hard, play-hard reputation -- lunch service that loosens into a rosé-fuelled afternoon session with music and a crowd that doesn't rush off the mountain. Chic enough to survive the transition from meal to party without missing a beat.
_facts: Located at Rue de Ransou 37, 1936 Verbier, Switzerland
Functions as both a restaurant and an après-ski terrace/bar
Known for panoramic views over the Val de Bagnes
Open daily through lunch and into the evening
